coverage: All practice entries in the supplied ML0–ML3 map, plus all practice summaries in the existing cockpit ML0–ML6 learning page. The complete official ML4–ML6 practice map was not available in these sources.

levels.name: Oblivious
levels.summary: Work relies on individuals; the need for a shared process is not yet recognized.
levels.summarySource: Paraphrase of supplied Module 2 maturity diagram

levels.name: Team-focused
levels.summary: Team collaboration and an emerging process; outcomes can remain inconsistent.
levels.summarySource: Paraphrase of supplied Module 2 maturity diagram

levels.name: Customer-Driven
levels.summary: A consistent process and customer awareness; outcomes can still be inconsistent.
levels.summarySource: Paraphrase of supplied Module 2 maturity diagram

levels.name: Fit-for-Purpose
levels.summary: Consistent outcomes that meet customer expectations.
levels.summarySource: Paraphrase of supplied Module 2 maturity diagram

levels.name: Risk-Hedged
levels.summary: Anticipate risk and improve the robustness of business economics.
levels.summarySource: Paraphrase of supplied Module 2 maturity diagram

levels.name: Market Leader
levels.summary: Organizational agility and delivery capability across the business.
levels.summarySource: Paraphrase of supplied Module 2 maturity diagram

levels.name: Built for Survival
levels.summary: Reinvention and resilience support long-term survival.
levels.summarySource: Paraphrase of supplied Module 2 maturity diagram
